title: Live deployment runs in the report
summary: Each live run row names its stage age, outstanding blocking QA and red requirements. Red means an unsettled blocking obligation whose latest actual attempt failed: a waived, superseded, replaced, triage-discharged or retracted requirement (including every requirement of a member removed with remove-item) is history, so the count matches what the run still grades. The section reads runs, members and requirements as sets, so a larger release costs the same statements.
